skill.name: Configure GitHub Actions Notebook Test Workflow
skill.description: Set up or update a GitHub Actions workflow file (test-notebooks.yml) that automatically executes Jupyter notebook integration tests on pull requests. The workflow triggers on PR events affecting agentops, examples, or tests directories; configures provider API keys from GitHub Actions secrets; installs the AgentOps package from the main branch; executes each notebook in the examples directory; and excludes notebooks requiring manual testing.
skill.skill_body:
Use this reference to set up or update a GitHub Actions workflow file (test-notebooks.yml) that automatically runs Jupyter notebook integration tests on pull requests. The workflow should trigger on PR events affecting agentops, examples, or tests directories; set up provider API keys from secrets; install the package from the main branch; execute each notebook; and exclude notebooks requiring manual testing.

## Objective

Provide reference specification for automated notebook test execution in CI/CD pipeline
## Applicable Signals

- Setting up or updating CI/CD pipeline for notebook-based integration tests
- Configuring GitHub Actions workflows for LLM provider testing
- Managing automated test execution on pull requests
- Establishing provider coverage and test patterns

## Contraindications

- Using alternative CI/CD platforms (Jenkins, GitLab CI, CircleCI, etc.)
- Manual testing workflow preferred over automation
- Notebooks that require interactive user input or manual verification

## Workflow Steps

- Create workflow file at .github/workflows/test-notebooks.yml
- Define trigger: pull_request events on paths agentops/**, examples/**, tests/**
- Configure job to set up environment with provider API keys from secrets
- Install AgentOps package from main branch
- Execute each notebook in examples/ directory
- Exclude notebooks listed in exclude_notebooks configuration
- Report test results back to PR

## Constraints

- Workflow must trigger on PR events affecting agentops/, examples/, or tests/ directories
- Provider API keys must be configured as GitHub Actions secrets
- Package must be installed from main branch for testing
- Notebooks requiring manual testing must be explicitly excluded from automated runs

## Cautions

- Ensure all required provider API keys are added to GitHub Actions secrets before enabling workflow
- Test against multiple Python versions to catch version-specific issues
- Keep exclude_notebooks list updated when adding new manual-testing notebooks

## Output Contract

- Workflow file (test-notebooks.yml) configured and committed to repository
- Automated tests execute on PR events
- Test results reported in PR checks
- Notebooks demonstrating basic completion calls, streaming responses, async operations, error handling, and tool usage are executed
